description: This file defines a test configuration class in Java for setting up stub beans related to JdbcTemplate and DataSource, mainly for testing purposes without connecting to a real database.

classes.name: test_JdbcTemplateTestConfig
classes.description: A Spring test configuration class that provides stub beans for DataSource and JdbcTemplate to facilitate testing without a real database connection.

methods.name: dataSource
methods.description: Defines a DataSource bean that throws SQLExceptions for connection attempts, used as a stub during testing.

methods.name: jdbcTemplate
methods.description: Defines a JdbcTemplate bean that uses the stub DataSource to satisfy dependencies in tests.
